text: Register once per subject; a replay with the same request key returns the original member ID. Conflicting reuse of a key or an existing subject is rejected.
criteria: Send the same registration twice and concurrently: one member ID and one registration change; conflicting payload with that key is rejected.

text: A member reads/updates only their own permitted fields; only staff can change branch/status.
criteria: `user-002` requests M-001 and attempts to set their own status: denied, with stored records unchanged.

text: Every amendment requires the expected version. Of two conflicting updates based on version 1, at most one succeeds.
criteria: Two writers submit expected version 1: one new version 2 and its matching change record; the loser receives a conflict.

text: List by branch and status with an opaque continuation token; limit a page to 25 records.
criteria: Page a fixed 61-record branch/status set: 25, 25 and 11 records, with no missing/duplicate IDs.

text: Atomically retain a change record with every accepted mutation; rejected operations produce no misleading accepted-change record.
criteria: Two writers submit expected version 1: one new version 2 and its matching change record; the loser receives a conflict.
Inject failure before committing the mutation/history transaction: neither half persists; retry creates one coherent change.

text: At 500 synthetic members, meet the shared metadata-API target and return complete paged results under a quiescent dataset.
criteria: Measure the shared load profile; retain latency distribution, configuration and failures rather than only a pass label.
